name: voiceassistant
description: Fast local desktop helper for technical questions.

scripts.verify: npm run test:knowledge && npm run test:launcher && npm run test:backend && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build -w @voiceassistant/shared && npm run build -w @voiceassistant/backend && npm run build -w @voiceassistant/desktop
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build && npm run build:packaged-backend && npm run package -w @voiceassistant/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build && npm run build:packaged-backend && npm run dist -w @voiceassistant/desktop
